answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 12 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in inlet, verified in forge, and pearl names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 7 hours of verification and 23 percent more locked value.
